hpi: Clinical Summary: This patient was admitted with neutropenic fever. Tumor lysis syndrome was considered. The patient was started on IV fluids, antibiotics, and supportive care. The patient was admitted to the ICU for close monitoring and further management. The patient was noted to have a high ANC, >500, but the patient was still at risk for infection. It is important to understand the severity of the patient's neutropenia. In this case, the patient is severely neutropenic.
